criteria.statement: A test shows the report refuses on a judge model, rubric revision, or reference-hash mismatch and prints each reason
A test with fixture runs shows all five transition counts with denominators and every right-to-wrong case id with transcript paths
A test shows tier 1-2 and tier 3 are never pooled and breakdowns by rules section, mechanic, difficulty, source pool and request kind appear
A test shows repeats resolve by majority and disagreeing repeats are listed unstable
A test shows identical-prompt-hash cases form the unchanged-input stratum labelled as sampling noise
A test shows latency mean/p50/p95, slower-than-timeout count, errors, tokens with reasoning, and answer and judge cost apart
A test shows diagnostic-arm results print under the diagnostic-control heading and the output never names a winner
`npm run eval:answer-quality:compare` exists in package.json and runs offline on two fixture run folders
